defmodule CacheClient.CircuitBreaker do use GenServer @failure_threshold 5 @reset_timeout 30_000 defstruct [:state, :failure_count, :last_failure_time, :node_ref] def start_link(opts) do GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__) end def init(opts) do {:ok, %__MODULE__{ state: :closed, failure_count: 0, last_failure_time: nil, node_ref: Keyword.get(opts, :node) }} end def call(key, operation) do GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:execute, key, operation}) end def handle_call({:execute, key, operation}, _from, %{state: :open} = state) do if System.monotonic_time(:millisecond) - state.last_failure_time > @reset_timeout do execute_with_halfopen(key, operation, %{state | state: :half_open}) else {:reply, {:error, :circuit_open}, state} end end def handle_call({:execute, key, operation}, _from, state) do execute_operation(key, operation, state) end defp execute_with_halfopen(key, operation, state) do case execute_remote(key, operation, state.node_ref) do {:ok, result} -> {:reply, {:ok, result}, %{state | state: :closed, failure_count: 0}} {:error, reason} -> {:reply, {:error, reason}, %{state | state: :open, last_failure_time: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)}} end end defp execute_operation(key, operation, state) do case execute_remote(key, operation, state.node_ref) do {:ok, result} -> {:reply, {:ok, result}, %{state | failure_count: 0}} {:error, reason} -> new_count = state.failure_count + 1 new_state = if new_count >= @failure_threshold do %{state | state: :open, failure_count: new_count, last_failure_time: System.monotonic_time(:millisecond)} else %{state | failure_count: new_count} end {:reply, {:error, reason}, new_state} end end defp execute_remote(key, operation, node_ref) do try do
